title: Company Goal Fabric: cross-team interlock checklist and surge capacity plan
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable, lightweight framework (the 'Goal Fabric') that maps company-level OKRs to cross-functional initiatives and embeds an interlock checklist, surge capacity plan, and decision/escalation protocol. This ticket covers the productization of the framework: templates, acceptance criteria, a Linear issue template, and a dashboard spec so PMs and org leads can run an aligned quarterly planning + mid-quarter rebalancing process. The intent is to reduce ad-hoc dependency friction, make resource tradeoffs explicit, and provide signals for when to trigger escalation or capacity reallocation.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable interlock checklist template exists in Confluence with explicit owners for each item
Linear issue template created and published under Product planning for all company-level initiatives
Pilot run across 2 cross-functional initiatives with documented outcomes and a retrospective
Dashboard wireframe and data requirements documented; Finance provides baseline capacity lines for Q2
Runbook for mid-quarter surge activation (who can approve, cost visibility, rollback) is reviewed and signed off by Product, Eng, and Finance
stakeholders: Product leadership (PMs and Head of Product)
decisions: Pilot scope limited to two initiatives: runtime performance SLOs and Console rollout UX
Surge approvals will default to Head of Product + Eng Director for cost < $50k; Finance sign-off required above
Use Linear tags `goal-fabric` and `interlock` for automation and reporting
Adopt weekly 15-minute interlock sync during planning windows for initiative owners
